measures: precision against a dense confusable answer set, and recall by rephrasing type
headline: precision — see does_not_measure for why hit rate is context only
does_not_measure: cache hit rate as a product figure — 27 answers over ~1,500 queries makes it a corpus property
end-to-end latency or token savings — generation never runs
entity handling — placeholders are filled with one fixed value each, so entity_guard is unloaded
over-serving on out-of-domain queries, unless --hold-out-categories is used: otherwise every query has a correct answer in cache

dataset.name: bitext/Bitext-customer-support-llm-chatbot-training-dataset
dataset.canonical_answer_rule: first row of each intent in dataset order — ARBITRARY, not selected. Each row carries its own generated response, so the dataset has no canonical answer; electing one is something this benchmark does to the dataset, not a property of it.
dataset.provenance_caveat: NLG-expanded from natural seed text under computational-linguist curation, per the dataset card. Curated variations, not logged production traffic — and not authored by this project, which is why it was chosen.
dataset.placeholders: filled with one fixed value each; see dataset.PLACEHOLDER_FILL

held_out.note: every serve here is wrong by construction — the answer was never cached

exact_match_check.note: byte-identical re-sends, excluded from every score. Expected ~100%; anything lower means the seeding pass did not populate the cache and no other number in this report is meaningful.

retrieval_reach.note: found_but_not_served is the cost of serve_threshold on this workload: the correct answer was the top candidate and accumulated confidence did not clear the bar

threshold_sweep_caveat: PROJECTED, NOT MEASURED. ADDED 2026-09-23, AFTER THIS RUN: this key was not written by the harness that produced this file, it was added later and the provenance block above does not cover it. threshold_sweep re-reads this run's confidences against a different bar without re-running, so it cannot see that under --warm a lower threshold serves more, writes fewer entries, and leaves later queries a sparser cache. Live runs at serve_threshold 0.80 and 0.75 on the held-out warm arm (commit 184da23) show the projection understates wrong serves by 2.6x at 0.80 and 1.9x at 0.75, always in the reassuring direction. Do not quote a row as a measurement. The blocks are kept because a labelled projection is useful; an unlabelled one is what cost a day. See the threshold_sweep docstring in run_support_benchmark.py.

confusion_projected.basis: projected from best_candidate, not measured — see confusion_at docstring

by_variation.meaning: errors and typos ('how can i activaet my card')

layer_coverage.note: answer-key match; contributes 1.0 and returns immediately

fires only on comparison phrasing — decompose_query is a regex over compare/vs/versus/differences between, so questions with separable parts that do not use those words are never decomposed (see BACKLOG item 7)
token overlap or edit distance, graded by measured similarity

traverses links learned from semantic near-misses in the link_learn_min..link_learn_max band; needs a query to be revisited after the link exists, so a single pass over distinct queries cannot reach it
embedding search over facts extracted from cached ANSWER text, not from ingested documents; needs answers of at least fact_min_answer_length (100) chars whose sentences survive a 30-char floor

contributes 0.0 by design. The Batch 2 rewrite removed the flat +0.25 and made this layer resolve the query against history rather than vote on it, so it is carried as context for a miss. It will always read contributed N, decisive 0, and that is the layer working correctly
penalty, not a match — subtracts confidence when a served candidate fails source verification, so it appears under 'blocked', never 'decisive'
penalty, and off by default (promotion_config.enabled); silent unless LLM promotion verification is switched on
